<style>
:root{--navy:#0a1c3d;--navy2:#0f2a5c;--blue:#1d6bff;--sky:#e9f1ff;--amber:#ffb400;--red:#e63946;--ink:#12213f;--mut:#5b6b88;--bg:#f6f8fc}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;line-height:1.6;overflow-x:hidden}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.wrap{width:min(1180px,92%);margin:0 auto}
.demo{background:#06122a;color:#9fb4de;font-size:12.5px;text-align:center;padding:7px 12px}.demo b{color:var(--amber)}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(10,28,61,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:74px}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#fff}
.crest{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),#0b3fb3);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.5px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(29,107,255,.45)}
.logo b{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.5px;display:block;line-height:1.1}.logo small{font-size:10.5px;color:#9db3df;letter-spacing:1.6px;text-transform:uppercase}
nav ul{display:flex;gap:30px;list-style:none}nav a{color:#d5e0f7;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;transition:.2s}nav a:hover{color:var(--amber)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:50px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;border:0;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}
.btn-a{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffc933,var(--amber));color:#1a1300;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(255,180,0,.35)}.btn-a:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(255,180,0,.5)}
.btn-g{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35)}.btn-g:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
.btn-w{background:#25d366;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(37,211,102,.35)}.btn-w:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.burger{display:none;background:none;border:0;color:#fff;font-size:28px;cursor:pointer}
.hero{position:relative;color:#fff;min-height:640px;display:flex;align-items:center;background:var(--navy);overflow:hidden}
.hero .bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 78% 30%,rgba(29,107,255,.45),transparent 55%),radial-gradient(circle at 10% 90%,rgba(255,180,0,.14),transparent 45%),linear-gradient(160deg,#0a1c3d,#06122a);animation:drift 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate}

.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:140px;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#fff,transparent);opacity:0}
@keyframes drift{to{filter:hue-rotate(12deg) brightness(1.08)}}@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-12px)}}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:70px 0 110px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:50px;align-items:center}.hero .l{min-width:0}.hp{position:relative;animation:float 6s ease-in-out infinite}.hp img{border-radius:26px;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.5);border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18)}.hp .fb{position:absolute;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:16px;padding:12px 18px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.35);display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}.hp .fb small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}.hp .f1{left:-26px;bottom:48px}.hp .f2{right:-14px;top:26px}
.tag{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:rgba(255,180,0,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,180,0,.55);color:#ffd266;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:30px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.5px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(40px,6.2vw,76px);line-height:1.04;font-weight:800;margin:22px 0 20px;max-width:760px;letter-spacing:-1px}
.hero h1 span{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--amber),#ff7a45);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero p{font-size:18.5px;color:#cfdcf6;max-width:560px}
.cta{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px}.chips span{font-size:13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);padding:7px 14px;border-radius:30px;color:#e4ecfb}
.stats{position:relative;z-index:5;margin-top:-62px}
.stats .wrap{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(10,28,61,.18);display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);padding:28px 10px}
.st{text-align:center;padding:6px 10px;border-right:1px solid #e6ecf6}.st:last-child{border:0}
.st b{display:block;font-size:34px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue);line-height:1.1}.st span{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut)}
section{padding:96px 0}
.eyebrow{color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2.4px;text-transform:uppercase}
h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,46px);line-height:1.12;font-weight:800;margin:10px 0 14px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
.lead{color:var(--mut);font-size:17px;max-width:640px}
.center{text-align:center}.center .lead{margin:0 auto}
.grid{display:grid;gap:22px;margin-top:48px}.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4eaf5;border-radius:20px;padding:30px 26px;transition:.3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:0 22px 44px rgba(29,107,255,.16);border-color:#bcd2ff}
.card:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:4px;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--amber));transition:.4s}.card:hover:before{width:100%}
.ic{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--sky);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:28px;margin-bottom:18px}
.card h3{font-size:18.5px;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700}.card p{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.alt{background:var(--bg)}
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center}
.photo{position:relative}.photo img{border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(10,28,61,.28);width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover}
.photo:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-14px 14px 14px -14px;border:3px solid var(--amber);border-radius:28px;z-index:-1}
.badge{position:absolute;right:-16px;bottom:30px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:16px 22px;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}.badge b{display:block;font-size:26px;color:var(--amber);line-height:1}.badge span{font-size:12.5px;color:#b9c9e8}
ul.ticks{list-style:none;margin:24px 0 30px}ul.ticks li{padding:9px 0 9px 38px;position:relative;font-weight:500}
ul.ticks li:before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;top:10px;width:25px;height:25px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-size:13px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.dark{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy),#071530);color:#fff}.dark .lead{color:#b8c8e6}.dark .eyebrow{color:var(--amber)}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:50px;counter-reset:s}
.step{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:20px;padding:28px 24px;counter-increment:s;transition:.3s}.step:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.11);transform:translateY(-6px)}
.step:before{content:"0" counter(s);font-size:40px;font-weight:800;color:var(--amber);display:block;line-height:1;margin-bottom:12px}
.step h3{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:6px}.step p{font-size:14px;color:#b8c8e6}
.dur{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:46px}
.price{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:34px 28px;text-align:center;border:1px solid #e4eaf5;transition:.3s}.price.hot{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy2),var(--navy));color:#fff;transform:scale(1.04);box-shadow:0 26px 54px rgba(10,28,61,.35)}
.price b{font-size:44px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue);display:block;line-height:1}.price.hot b{color:var(--amber)}.price h3{margin:10px 0 8px}.price p{font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)}.price.hot p{color:#b8c8e6}
.gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);grid-auto-rows:210px;gap:16px;margin-top:46px}
.gal div{border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}.gal img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:.6s}.gal div:hover img{transform:scale(1.1)}
.gal .w2{grid-column:span 2}.gal .h2{grid-row:span 2}
.gal span{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:12px;color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.gal div:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(6,18,42,.6),transparent 55%)}.gal span{z-index:2}
.motors{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0;border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(10,28,61,.18)}
.motors .t{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#d9232f,#9e1019);color:#fff;padding:54px 46px}.motors .t h2{color:#fff}.motors .t p{color:#ffd9dc}
.motors img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;min-height:340px}
.loc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;margin-top:44px}
.loc .card h3{color:var(--blue)}
.apply{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--blue),#0b3fb3);color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.apply:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:520px;height:520px;border-radius:50%;right:-120px;top:-180px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.apply .box{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.apply h2{color:#fff}.apply p{color:#d6e4ff}
form{background:#fff;border-radius:24px;padding:34px;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
form label{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);display:block;margin:12px 0 6px}
form input,form select{width:100%;padding:14px 16px;border:1.5px solid #dbe4f3;border-radius:12px;font:inherit;font-size:15px;background:#fff}form input:focus,form select:focus{outline:0;border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(29,107,255,.15)}
form .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:22px}
footer{background:#06122a;color:#9fb4de;padding:60px 0 26px;font-size:14.5px}
.fg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px}.fg h4{color:#fff;margin-bottom:14px}.fg a{display:block;padding:4px 0}.fg a:hover{color:var(--amber)}
.copy{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);margin-top:40px;padding-top:20px;text-align:center;font-size:13px}
.wa{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:60;width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:50%;background:#25d366;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:32px;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(37,211,102,.55);animation:pulse 2.2s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(37,211,102,.6),0 12px 30px rgba(37,211,102,.5)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 22px rgba(37,211,102,0),0 12px 30px rgba(37,211,102,.5)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(37,211,102,0)}}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(34px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease}.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(max-width:980px){.g4,.steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.g3,.dur{grid-template-columns:1fr}.split,.apply .box,.motors,.loc,.fg{grid-template-columns:1fr}.split{gap:40px}.gal{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.price.hot{transform:none}
 nav{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:74px;background:var(--navy);display:none;padding:12px 6% 24px}nav.open{display:block}nav ul{flex-direction:column;gap:6px}nav a{display:block;padding:12px 0}.burger{display:block}.nav>.btn{display:none}
 .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-bottom:100px}.hp{max-width:460px;margin:10px auto 0}.hp .f1{left:-6px}.hp .f2{right:-6px}.stats .wrap{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);row-gap:18px}.st:nth-child(2){border:0}.photo:before{display:none}.badge{right:10px}}
@media(max-width:560px){section{padding:68px 0}.g4,.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{min-height:620px}.hero p{font-size:16.5px}.gal{grid-auto-rows:170px}.motors .t{padding:36px 26px}form{padding:24px}.btn{padding:13px 22px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.rv{opacity:1;transform:none}}
</style></head><body>

</div></div>

</div></div>

<section id="programs"><div class="wrap">
 <div class="center rv"><span class="eyebrow">Our programs</span><h2>Skills for the cars of today and tomorrow</h2><p class="lead">From classic engine repair to electric vehicles, choose the path that fits your future.</p></div>
 <div class="grid g4">
  <div class="card rv"><div class="ic">⚙️</div><h3>Auto Mechatronics</h3><p>Diagnose and repair modern vehicles with electronics, sensors and scan tools.</p></div>
  <div class="card rv"><div class="ic">🔋</div><h3>Electric Vehicle (EV) Technology</h3><p>Batteries, motors and charging systems for the fast-growing EV industry.</p></div>
  <div class="card rv"><div class="ic">⛽</div><h3>CNG Vehicle Technology</h3><p>Install and service compressed natural gas systems safely and correctly.</p></div>
  <div class="card rv"><div class="ic">💻</div><h3>ICT</h3><p>Computer and digital skills to run a modern workshop and business.</p></div>
  <div class="card rv"><div class="ic">🚗</div><h3>Driving School</h3><p>Learn to drive with experienced instructors and build real road confidence.</p></div>
  <div class="card rv"><div class="ic">🛠️</div><h3>Workshop Management</h3><p>Run a profitable workshop: service advising, records, customers and teams.</p></div>
  <div class="card rv"><div class="ic">📈</div><h3>Entrepreneurship Studies</h3><p>Turn your skill into a business that employs others.</p></div>
  <div class="card rv"><div class="ic">🎨</div><h3>Auto Spray Painting &amp; Wheel Alignment</h3><p>Body finishing, wheel balance and alignment, taught on real vehicles.</p></div>
 </div>
</div></section>

<section class="alt" id="why"><div class="wrap split">
 <div class="rv"><span class="eyebrow">Why Floritech</span><h2>Training that leads to a job or your own business</h2>
  <p class="lead">We teach in a real working workshop, so every student practises on real vehicles and graduates ready for work.</p>
  <ul class="ticks"><li>NABTEB and NSQ certified, so your certificate is recognised</li><li>Practical, hands-on workshop learning</li><li>Experienced trainers and modern equipment</li><li>Hostel accommodation available on campus</li><li>Flexible durations: 3 months, 6 months, 1 to 2 years</li></ul>
  <a class="btn btn-a" href="#apply">Reserve your space →</a></div>
 <div class="photo rv"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Students working on an engine"><div class="badge"><b>Learn, Fix &amp; Earn</b><span>Our promise to every student</span></div></div>
</div></section>

<section class="dark" id="how"><div class="wrap">
 <div class="center rv"><span class="eyebrow">How it works</span><h2>From enquiry to certificate in four steps</h2><p class="lead">Simple, clear and designed around you.</p></div>
 <div class="steps">
  <div class="step rv"><h3>Enquire</h3><p>Call or message us on WhatsApp and tell us what you want to learn.</p></div>
  <div class="step rv"><h3>Register</h3><p>Pick your program and level, and secure your space (spaces are limited).</p></div>
  <div class="step rv"><h3>Train</h3><p>Learn in class and practise daily in the workshop on real vehicles.</p></div>
  <div class="step rv"><h3>Get certified</h3><p>Sit your assessment and graduate with a NABTEB or NSQ certificate.</p></div>
 </div>
</div></section>

<section id="duration"><div class="wrap">
 <div class="center rv"><span class="eyebrow">Duration</span><h2>Choose the length that fits you</h2><p class="lead">Short skill courses or full certification tracks. Call for current fees.</p></div>
 <div class="dur">
  <div class="price rv"><b>3</b><h3>Months</h3><p>Fast-track skill course to start earning quickly.</p></div>
  <div class="price hot rv"><b>6</b><h3>Months</h3><p>Our most popular route: deeper practice and certification.</p></div>
  <div class="price rv"><b>1–2</b><h3>Years</h3><p>Full training through NSQ and trade test levels for a complete career.</p></div>
 </div>
 <p class="center rv" style="margin-top:34px;color:var(--mut)"><b>Certificates:</b> NSQ Levels · NABTEB Modular · Trade Test Levels 1 to 3</p>
</div></section>

<section class="apply" id="apply"><div class="wrap box">
 <div class="rv"><span class="eyebrow" style="color:#ffd266">Admission</span><h2>Admission into Levels 1 to 3 is currently on</h2><p style="font-size:17px">Limited space available. Send your details and we will contact you on WhatsApp.</p>
  <p style="margin-top:22px"><b>📞 07035908164</b><br><b>📞 08180954199</b><br>✉️ floritechmotors@gmail.com</p></div>
 <form class="rv" onsubmit="go(event)">
  <label>Full name</label><input id="n" required placeholder="Your name">
